title: No public interest in retaining personal details of man online in quashed case: Bombay High Court
description: The Bombay High Court has directed its registry to anonymise the name of an environment and climate change consultant in all digital court records in relation to a quashed criminal case [ABC v. State of Maharashtra & Ors.]A Division Bench of Justices Urmila Joshi‑Phalke and Nivedita P Mehta reiterated that the right to privacy is a well‑established fundamental right under the Constitution.The concept of right to privacy incorporates the right to be forgotten, the Court said.
